entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A human planeswalker from Capenna, haunted by childhood captivity under the Phyrexians, who ascended into an archangel planeswalker during the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Capenna
entities.description: Elspeth's home plane, which contains the metropolis of New Capenna and was once dominated by Phyrexians.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The Phyrexian forces who imprisoned Elspeth as a child and later invaded Mirrodin and the multiverse.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: An angelic figure whose voice bestowed the power of an archangel on Elspeth.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: A shard of Alara where Elspeth found peace and became a knight.

entities.name: Valeron
entities.description: The nation of Bant where Elspeth settled and trained as a squire.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker and Elspeth's old friend, later compleated.

entities.name: Aran
entities.description: Elspeth's squire, who fell in battle and was revived by her.

entities.name: Rafiq
entities.description: The Bant Knight-General Elspeth served and helped kill Malfegor.

entities.name: Malfegor
entities.description: A demon killed by Rafiq and Elspeth, ending Bant's part in the Conflux war.

entities.name: Gwafa Hazid
entities.description: A figure Elspeth interrogated about the destruction of Giltspire Castle.

entities.name: Koth
entities.description: A Vulshok geomancer planeswalker who vowed to stop the Phyrexians and brought Elspeth to Mirrodin.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: An artificer planeswalker who gave his life and spark to cure Karn.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A golem corrupted by Phyrexian oil, cured by Venser, who asked the group to lead the resistance.

entities.name: Melira
entities.description: A Mirran born without metal who is immune to phyresis and heals the infected.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker who guided the companions and spared Elspeth's life later.

entities.name: Ezuri
entities.description: The leader of a band of Mirran rebels.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: A Phyrexian who led a group chasing the companions.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The Phyrexian Grand Praetor who seized power over other praetors' territories.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The metal plane invaded by Phyrexia and become New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: The plane Elspeth first planeswalked to and where she became Heliod's champion.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: The Theran god of the sun who sought to destroy Elspeth.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: A Theran god whose Sword of Chaos Elspeth found.

entities.name: Daxos
entities.description: A Theran man who grew close to Elspeth and was accidentally killed by her.

entities.name: Xenagos
entities.description: A satyr who manipulated the Great Revel and the gods, and controlled Elspeth.

entities.name: Polukranos
entities.description: A massive hydra that Elspeth slew.

entities.name: Brimaz
entities.description: A leonin who helped Elspeth reunite with Ajani.

entities.name: Kiora
entities.description: A merfolk planeswalker who posed as the mariner Callaphe.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: The god of the dead who allowed Elspeth to enter Nyx and imprisoned Heliod.

entities.name: Kruphix
entities.description: The god who enacted the Silence of the Gods.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: The Theran god of the sea.

entities.name: Klothys
entities.description: The God of Destiny who sent Calix to bring Elspeth back.

entities.name: Calix
entities.description: A Nyxborn sent to capture Elspeth who later follows her.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: A planeswalker who spread nightmares throughout Theros.

entities.name: Xander
entities.description: The leader of the Maestros family on New Capenna.

entities.name: Anhelo
entities.description: The Maestros' vampire lieutenant who invited Elspeth to join the family.

entities.name: Giada
entities.description: A companion who sacrificed herself to rearm Elspeth.

entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: A planeswalker who helped Elspeth on New Capenna.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A demon who attacked Elspeth in a cathedral on New Capenna.

entities.name: Godsend
entities.description: A holy swordspear crafted by Purphoros and remade by Heliod from the Sword of Chaos.

entities.name: Shadowspear
entities.description: Heliod's spear Khrusor pulled from a nightmare and turned into a real weapon.

entities.name: Luxior
entities.description: A Halo-infused sword Elspeth wielded.

entities.name: Filigree Sylex
entities.description: The artifact Elspeth took from Jace and carried into the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: The Invasion Tree at the Seedcore of New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The planeswalker group that recruited Elspeth to fight the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker infected by Phyrexia who carried the Sylex.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker freed by Elspeth from Nissa's grasp.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A compleated planeswalker knocked out by Elspeth.

entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: A planeswalker who bonded with the Invasion Tree.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor Elspeth blocked.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon planeswalker infected with phyresis.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A planeswalker who sacrificed herself to explode Sheoldred's Coliseum.

entities.name: Tibalt
entities.description: A planeswalker who fought alongside Ajani in the Seedcore.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: A planeswalker who traveled with Elspeth during the dragonstorms.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A desparked planeswalker who took control of Tarkir's wild dragons.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A Spirit Dragon who defeated Sarkhan with ghostfire.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The nameless dragon sealed in Meditation Realm who escaped.

entities.name: Great Revel
entities.description: A festival suborned by Xenagos.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane where dragonstorms attacked.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: The plane to which the Mirrans evacuated.

entities.name: Ghirapur Grand Prix
entities.description: The race where Elspeth defeated a dragon.

entities.name: Avishkar
entities.description: The region of Kaladesh where Elspeth fought a dragon.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: The space between planes where Elspeth ascended.

events.summary: Elspeth and her mother are captured by Phyrexians and held in prison.
events.quote: When she was thirteen years old, she and her mother were captured by Phyrexians and held in prison a stone's throw from her childhood village.

events.summary: A Phyrexian tears out her mother's throat before her eyes.
events.quote: her mother's throat was torn out in front of her by a Phyrexian

events.summary: Before vivisection, Elspeth's spark ignites and she planeswalks to Theros.
events.quote: her Planeswalker's spark ignited and she planeswalked away, landing on Theros

events.summary: Elspeth is knighted on Bant at a very young age.
events.quote: In three years she was knighted, younger than almost anyone.

events.summary: Elspeth nurses the broken Ajani back to health.
events.quote: she nursed Ajani Goldmane back to health

events.summary: In the Grixis incursion Elspeth unleashes her full powers and revives her squire Aran.
events.quote: She cast aside all the rules of civil warfare that Bant cherished and unleashed her full powers, devastating her enemies and bringing Aran back to life.

events.summary: Elspeth helps Rafiq kill Malfegor, ending Bant's part in the Conflux war.
events.quote: she assisted Rafiq in killing Malfegor

events.summary: Bant forever changed, Elspeth planeswalks away.
events.quote: With a heavy heart, she planeswalked away.

events.summary: Elspeth fights in gladiatorial pits in exile.
events.quote: she began fighting in gladiatorial pits, misusing her training as a knight to win.

events.summary: Koth encases Venser's head in stone to force him to Mirrodin.
events.quote: Koth flew into a rage and encased his head in a stone mask, coercing him to walk to Mirrodin.

events.summary: Elspeth breaks into Ish Sah and frees her companions.
events.quote: she made her way to where they were held and cut a swath of destruction to them

events.summary: The companions fight Phyrexian butchers and escape through a meat shaft.
events.quote: Elspeth slew many, but they were outnumbered

events.summary: Elspeth rages and slays every Phyrexian in a surgery room, freeing Melira.
events.quote: slaying all the Phyrexians in the room in a matter of moments

events.summary: Melira heals the infected rebels at Ezuri's camp.
events.quote: She healed all those in the camp who were infected by the glistening oil

events.summary: Venser gives his life and spark to Karn, curing the golem.
events.quote: Venser gave his life and spark to Karn, curing the golem.

events.summary: The resistance is slaughtered and Koth sacrifices himself to let a wounded Elspeth escape.
events.quote: a Phyrexian Obliterator grievously injured the trapped knight before she could leave

events.summary: Elspeth flees Heliod with the Sword of Chaos, which he later remakes into Godsend.
events.quote: he transformed the blade into a spear he dubbed Godsend

events.summary: Elspeth slays the hydra Polukranos and becomes Heliod's champion.
events.quote: Elspeth engaged the hydra with the help of Daxos and succeeded where so many had failed, slaying it.

events.summary: Elspeth and Daxos realize their feelings after Akros is saved.
events.quote: Daxos and Elspeth finally realize their feelings for each other.

events.summary: Xenagos controls Elspeth; she kills the Obliterator in her memory and realizes she has killed Daxos.
events.quote: only realizing too late that she had just killed Daxos

events.summary: Heliod turns against Elspeth, believing she was part of Xenagos's plan.
events.quote: Heliod was wroth, believing she was implicit in Xenagos's plan, and sought to destroy her.

events.summary: Callaphe is revealed to be the planeswalker Kiora.
events.quote: Callaphe revealed that her identity was a falsehood and that she was in truth the merfolk planeswalker Kiora

events.summary: Elspeth smashes the false-life goblet and passes Erebos's ordeal.
events.quote: Though it broke her heart, she smashed the cup and passed Erebos's ordeal.

events.summary: In Nyx Elspeth strikes down Xenagos.
events.quote: They confronted Xenagos and battled the god until at last Elspeth struck him down

events.summary: Heliod fatally wounds Elspeth with her own weapon.
events.quote: using her weapon fatally wounded Elspeth

events.summary: Elspeth drowns in the Underworld until her spark reignites.
events.quote: She drowned until her spark reignited in a blinding light.

events.summary: Elspeth pulls Heliod's spear from a nightmare, turning it into Shadowspear.
events.quote: Elspeth pulled Heliod's spear, Khrusor

events.summary: With Shadowspear acknowledged as the true Khrusor, Heliod yields and Erebos imprisons him in the Underworld.
events.quote: The God of the Sun was forced to yield and Erebos imprisoned him in the Underworld forever.

events.summary: Elspeth travels to New Capenna to learn how its people defeated the Phyrexians.
events.quote: Elspeth decided to go to New Capenna

events.summary: Elspeth routs Maestros enforcers and is invited to join the family by Anhelo.
events.quote: Dispatching the thugs, Elspeth was approached by Anhelo, the Maestros' vampire lieutenant, who invited her to join the family.

events.summary: Giada sacrifices herself to rearm Elspeth, who wounds Nixilis with Luxior.
events.quote: she was able to strike a deadly blow against Nixilis, forcing him to planeswalk away to safety.

events.summary: Elspeth learns of Ajani's Compleation and takes it hard.
events.quote: she learned about Ajani's Compleation and took the news hard

events.summary: Jace reacts adversely to the Halo elixir and collapses.
events.quote: Jace inexplicably reacted adversely to the potent elixir and collapsed.

events.summary: Vraska succumbs to phyresis and infects Jace.
events.quote: Vraska succumbed to the Phyrexian influence and infected Jace in turn.

events.summary: Nahiri sacrifices herself by exploding Sheoldred's Coliseum.
events.quote: Nahiri, who was also infected, decided to sacrifice herself for the greater good.

events.summary: Elspeth knocks Ajani out, stabs Jace and vanishes with the Sylex.
events.quote: she knocked Ajani unconscious and ran further into the Seedcore

events.summary: In the Blind Eternities Serra bestows the power of an archangel on Elspeth.
events.quote: bestowed the power of an archangel onto Elspeth

events.summary: Elspeth emerges and blocks Jin-Gitaxias from compleating the captured planeswalkers.
events.quote: Elspeth emerged from the Blind Eternities and blocked Jin-Gitaxias from advancing.

events.summary: Elspeth frees Chandra from Nissa so Wrenn can bond with the Invasion Tree.
events.quote: Elspeth freed Chandra from Nissa's grasp

events.summary: Elspeth knocks out Nissa so Chandra can carry her to safety.
events.quote: Elspeth knocked out Nissa with the hilt of her sword, allowing Chandra to carry her to safety.

events.summary: Elspeth defeats a dragon at the Ghirapur Grand Prix and heals Chandra.
events.quote: She then healed Chandra's wounds and informed her and Nissa that dragonstorms were moving through Omenpaths.

events.summary: Elspeth defeats the desparked Sarkhan at the Crucible of the Spirit Dragon.
events.quote: Sarkhan engaged Elspeth in battle but his desparked form was no match for the archangel and he was quickly defeated.

events.summary: Jace's attempt to recreate the Multiverse collapses, unmaking reality and Jace.
events.quote: Jace ran out of mana and the spell collapsed.

events.summary: Ugin defeats Sarkhan, but Bolas has escaped in the aftermath.
events.quote: Ugin appeared and immediately defeated Sarkhan with his ghostfire

relations.quote: she reunited with her old friend Ajani

succeeded where so many had failed, slaying it
